description: A first-class Portfolio section where learners assemble end-to-end case studies from artifacts they produce during lessons and capstones. The curriculum is designed to 'teach toward' this: each phase is fully taught before a learner needs it, and relevant lessons emit the exact artifact each phase requires.
notes: Spec/rules files reference modern naming (AGENTS.md / .cursor/rules); .cursorrules is shown as legacy.
Observability tools referenced: LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix.

A portfolio entry = ordered phases; each phase pulls in artifacts the learner produced (or uploads); supports diagrams/code/charts; exports to a shareable public page alongside the pathway certificate.

phases.name: Use Case Identification & Business Case
items: Problem statement (the manual bottleneck / cost / latency)
AI opportunity (why agentic vs simple software or a basic prompt)

phases.name: Spec-Driven Development & Architecture Design
items: System architecture diagram (single ReAct / router / supervisor-worker)

phases.name: Development Lifecycle & Orchestration
items: State management & memory (short-term + long-term / vector DB)
Code snapshot: tool calling, parsing non-deterministic output, structured JSON

phases.name: Observability & Debugging
items: Trace analysis snapshots (LangSmith / Langfuse / Arize Phoenix)
Failure-mode handling (API timeouts, context rot, empty responses)

phases.name: Evaluation & The Golden Dataset
items: Golden dataset (50-100 complex prompts + expected outputs)

phases.name: Production & Cost ROI Analysis
items: Token economics (input vs output cost per run)
Deployment / model-mixing strategy (small model for subagents, reasoning model for supervisor)

perPathFormats.note: Architecture-level, no deep code; or a no-code workflow case study.
The task automated + before/after time saved.
The acceptable-use / risk policy + HITL gatekeeping design.
